steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: enter-room-editor-and-seed
steps.eval: (function(){const s=window.__store.getState(); s.setUiMode('simple'); s.reresolveFeatureFlags(); s.enterRoomEditor('livingDining'); s.setItems([]); const room=s.floorPlan.rooms.find(r=>r.id==='livingDining'); const ax=room.origin[0]+1.0; const az=room.origin[1]+1.2; const bx=room.origin[0]+2.6; const bz=room.origin[1]+3.0; const a=s.addItem({defId:'armchair', position:[ax,az], rotation:0, props:{}}); const b=s.addItem({defId:'armchair', position:[bx,bz], rotation:Math.PI/2, props:{}}); window.__ids=[a,b]; s.setSelectedItemIds([a,b]);})()

steps.name: assert-simple-mirror-only-x
steps.eval: (function(){const s=window.__store.getState(); if (s.featureFlags.mirrorSelection) throw new Error('mirrorSelection should be OFF in Simple'); const btns=[...document.querySelectorAll('.panel.inspector button')].map(b=>b.textContent.trim()); if (!btns.includes('Mirror')) throw new Error('expected plain Mirror button in Simple'); if (btns.includes('Mirror Z')) throw new Error('Mirror Z must be hidden in Simple');})()

waitFor.store: (function(){const btns=[...document.querySelectorAll('.panel.inspector button')].map(b=>b.textContent.trim()); return btns.includes('Mirror X') && btns.includes('Mirror Z');})()

steps.name: click-mirror-x
steps.eval: (function(){const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('.panel.inspector button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='Mirror X'); if(!b) throw new Error('no Mirror X button'); b.click();})()

steps.name: click-mirror-z
steps.eval: (function(){const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('.panel.inspector button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='Mirror Z'); if(!b) throw new Error('no Mirror Z button'); b.click();})()
